slo_title: Explain the logic operation of the NAND gate and illustrate how it can be used to construct AND, OR, and NOT gates

mcq.q: Given that a NOR gate outputs 1 only when all inputs are 0, which Boolean expression represents the NOR of two inputs A and B?
How can you implement an AND gate using only NOR gates?

options.A: Take the NOR of the inputs, then NOR the result with itself
options.B: Take the NOR of the inputs twice in series
options.C: Take the NOR of the inputs, then invert each input with a NOR gate, then NOR the results
options.D: NOR gates cannot implement AND gates

mcq.answer_text: Take the NOR of the inputs, then invert each input with a NOR gate, then NOR the results

mcq.q: Which of the following statements about NAND and NOR gates is TRUE?

options.A: NAND gates are universal gates but NOR gates are not
options.B: Both NAND and NOR gates can be used to implement any logic function
options.C: NOR gates cannot be used to implement NOT gates
options.D: NAND gates can only implement NOT and AND gates

mcq.answer_text: Both NAND and NOR gates can be used to implement any logic function

mcq.q: To create an OR gate using only NAND gates, what is the sequence of operations?

options.B: NAND the inputs, then NAND the output with itself
options.C: NAND the inputs separately, then NAND the results

mcq.answer_text: NAND the inputs separately, then NAND the results

mcq.q: Which configuration of NAND gates produces a NOT operation on input A?

options.B: One input connected to A and the other to 0
options.C: One input connected to A and the other to 1
